lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a grid-like pattern in the upper right quadrant, forming at least two distinct horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a visible grid of anchor nodes on the upper flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the upper edge and shadowing below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of paired, elongated cylindrical anatomical structures protruding from the ventral posterior region of the torso.
